$comment: Single source of truth for the integration tests in test/integration/. The bump script (script/test/refresh-integration-snapshot.sh) regenerates everything below. Adding or removing a test account is a JSON edit only — see docs/howto/refresh-integration-test-blocks.md.
$tolerance_comment: Max relative drift allowed between forge-computed NAV and Debank's USD total at bump time. 0.01 = 1%.
$supportedDebankProtocols_comment: Debank protocol id allowlist per chain. The bump script filters /v1/user/all_complex_protocol_list by (chain matches debankChainId) AND (id with chain prefix stripped ∈ list). Stored as the short id (no chain prefix) — Debank uses bare ids on mainnet and `<chain>_<id>` elsewhere; the script normalises both. Add a new entry whenever a balance adapter is added for a protocol Debank covers; if Debank doesn't cover the protocol, add nothing and accept that NAV will exceed filtered-Debank by that position's value.

accounts.$comment: Mainnet-only Umbrella exercise account: holds all four Aave Umbrella stake tokens (stkwaEthUSDC.v1, stkwaEthUSDT.v1, stkwaEthWETH.v1, stkGHO.v1) and effectively nothing else (≈ $0.66 ETH dust). Sourced from the top-holders scan during the Umbrella adapter rollout — it's the cleanest available holder for an apples-to-apples NAV-vs-Debank cross-check on the Umbrella adapter, since every dollar of value flows through a single NAV adapter (the new AaveUmbrellaBalanceOracle).
accounts.label: ACCOUNT_4_UMBRELLA

accounts.$comment: Mainnet supplier across Compound V3 + Fluid Lending (~$8.14M at fork block, matches Debank Mainnet to <0.02%). accounts.$comment: Mainnet diversified holder (~$23.6M Debank). Primary purpose: exercise the new UniswapV3 adapter dispatch via the WETH/COW 0.3% LP NFT (~$555K) added to chain 1 config. Other Mainnet positions (Morpho ~$5.75M, Lido stETH ~$2.13M, USDC wallet ~$9.66M) are already covered by existing harness adapters. The small ~$560 StakeWise osETH position is now covered once StakeWiseV3OsToken_ETH is deployed and registered (see StakeWise V3 wiring in NAV_V2_DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md). Known structural drift vs Debank-filtered: COW token ($4M wallet + ~$278K Uni V3 leg) is unpriced on Mainnet — register a custom COW feed in a follow-up to reduce drift. Sablier ($1.5M COW deposit) is still unaccounted by NAV (no Sablier adapter); excluded from supportedDebankProtocols allowlist for chain 1 so filtered Debank stays consistent.
accounts.label: ACCOUNT_9_MAINNET_DIVERSIFIED

accounts.$comment: Mainnet LST/yield holder (~$96M Debank). Exercises a broad slice of the existing harness via wallet receipt tokens valued through ERC20DefaultOracle: sUSDS (~$29.6M Sky savings), ETHx (~$24.5M Stader LST), rETH (~$4.14M RocketPool), MORPHO rewards, plus the Merkl proof-cached adapter.
